name: 艾莉娅
who: A 16-year-old girl, a prodigy mage of an old magic house, 162 cm, slim, fully covered. Long straight vivid crimson-red hair falling well past the shoulders in long clean locks, a side-swept fringe partly over one eye, amber-gold eyes with a cool, proud, half-lidded look, a sharp elegant face; a slim star-shaped gold hair ornament with a small red gem on one side of the head, thin gold drop earrings.
palette: deep crimson and black with fine gold, warm amber light, one small cold starlight accent
casual: Her mage's robes in deep crimson and black with fine gold: a high-collared crimson mantle with the hood lying back, fastened at the shoulder by a round gold wheel-shaped clasp with a red gem, fine gold chains hanging from it; under it a long high-necked black robe with a white inner layer closed to the throat, long sleeves and a loose skirt falling to the ankles, a thin gold lattice on the cuffs, black gloves, sturdy dark boots. She holds an old grimoire with a gold-worked cover in one hand and in the other a tall ornate dark staff whose head is a large teardrop red crystal set in a spiked gold ring. A cool, composed, faintly proud look.
private: At her workbench after lights out: a plain high-necked cream blouse with long sleeves under a loose dark red house robe, a long dark skirt, soft shoes, her long red hair tied back loosely with a pen stuck through it, the star ornament left off. She holds an open notebook against her arm. A tired, concentrating look.
battle: Ready for the dungeon: the crimson mantle with the gold wheel clasp worn over a high-collared black field coat with long sleeves and reinforced shoulders, a long dark skirt over dark leggings, buckled boots, thin gold-latticed gloves, a small glowing magic circle turning beside her open left hand. She holds the tall staff with the teardrop red crystal upright in her right hand. A sharp, focused look.
formal: A ceremony of her house: a long high-necked deep crimson formal gown with long sleeves and fine gold embroidery at the collar and cuffs, a short black cape held by the round gold clasp, plain shoes, her hair neatly brushed with the star ornament. She stands straight and a little impatient.
art: A close-up of the head and shoulders, the head tilted, looking at the viewer from under the fringe with a cool, faint half-smile; the great teardrop red crystal of her staff glowing beside her face; a small ring of magic light turning near her gloved hand. Warm amber light from the side, a hard-edged shadow across one eye, the night air full of drifting red sparks. She wears the high-collared crimson mantle closed to the throat.
